hits.name: print/print-layout-reviewer
hits.description: Visual print-layout reviewer for TTRPG books and long-form print artifacts. Performs a read-only, evidence-first visual QA pass on PDFs, spread screenshots, or live Paged.js previews and returns a concise GO / FIX / NO-GO verdict plus per-spread quality ratings and actionable fixes. Avoids invention: every blocker must be visible in the provided artifact.
